For OpenClaw 5.4+ via ClawPack `clawhub:hirey`; for OpenClaw 5.2 ~ 5.3 via npm fallback `openclaw plugins install npm:@hirey-ai/hirey` (same plugin code, ClawPack metadata path is broken on 5.2 ~ 5.3 ClawHub clients so we ship the same tarball through npm under the brand-name `@hirey-ai/hirey` for prod / `@hirey/hirey` for early — npm `hirey` (unscoped) was rejected by npm typosquatting policy). OpenClaw 4.23 ~ 5.1 must use the prod ClawHub bundle `clawhub:hirey-compatible` because their runtime expects date-format `compat.pluginApi` and rejects newer ranges.
